description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface. It acts as a filter in a logging chain, passing through only the log message content without additional metadata, suitable for simple on-screen log display.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode filter that passes only the log message content, filtering out metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a next LogNode to chain logs.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters incoming log entries and passes only the message to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
